messages:
Maya DevEx: Quick sync — Q2 planning for SDK quickstarts, sample apps, and 'getting-started' docs. Need scope, launch criteria, and who owns what. TL;DR: customers ask for 3 opinionated sample apps + 4 quickstarts.
Sam (PM): Love it. Can we map each sample to an OKR? My proposal: 2 samples for conversion (embedding-search + summarization), 1 for enterprise usage (private deployment + auth).
Chris Eng SDK: High-level engineering constraints: one sample = ~2w dev + 1w docs + 1w polish. Quickstarts are cheaper: ~3-5d each. If we want 3 samples + 4 quickstarts that's ~8-10w eng. Need to prioritize.
Leila (Solutions): From the field: Enterprise POC requests often ask for streaming/chat + real-time embeddings. Start with a small, secure chat sample for Dedicated + a search sample for Hosted. The rest can be community samples.
Maya DevEx: Proposed scope to reduce effort: 2 fully-supported samples (search + chat), 1 community-contrib sample (repo template), and 4 quickstarts (python SDK, node SDK, cli scaffold, dockerized example). Launch criteria below.
Sam (PM): Launch criteria draft: 1) end-to-end tutorial passing smoke tests, 2) README + 2 short videos (<=3min), 3) 1 reproducible test harness, 4) telemetry hooks for usage metrics. Agree?
Chris Eng SDK: Agree but suggest we make smoke tests run in CI with a mocked Redwood API to avoid flakiness. I can add a test template in the SDK repo. Example mock snippet we can reuse:

```bash
# run local mock server for CI
python -m devex.mock_server --port 8080 --responses responses.json
```

Leila (Solutions): Also require a short enterprise checklist: auth examples (OIDC), config for VPC, and notes for Dedicated capacity. Otherwise SAs will rewrite.
devex-bot: Reminder: existing samplekit backlog items: SK-12 (embedding-search), SK-34 (stream-chat), SK-51 (cli-scaffold). See https://go/redwood/samples/backlog
Maya DevEx: Proposed owners: Chris -> eng SDK integration + smoke tests, Leila -> field requirements + enterprise checklist, Sam -> OKR mapping + launch comms, Maya -> docs + quickstarts. Timeline: Q2 week 1-6 design + MVP, week 7-10 polish + content, week 11 launch.
Sam (PM): If eng capacity is tight we can scope the community-contrib sample to be 'starter template' with contribution guide. That saves ~2w.
Chris Eng SDK: +1. Also call out measurable success metrics: adoption (starter-run count), conversion to paid Dedicated POC, and # of PRs from community.
Leila (Solutions): I can draft the enterprise checklist this week and share a short doc. Will also capture the top 3 customer asks to validate scope.
Maya DevEx: Action items: 1) Chris add CI mock + ETA 3/10, 2) Leila enterprise checklist + ETA 3/8, 3) Sam finalize OKR mapping + ETA 3/5, 4) Maya publish quickstart templates + ETA 3/12. Ping me if slips. :thumbsup:
Sam (PM): Scheduling a 30m sync Weds to lock final scope. I'll post calendar invite.
Chris Eng SDK: Noted. Will prototype mockServer this week.
Leila (Solutions): I'll post the first checklist draft in the thread.
Maya DevEx: Thanks all — small, opinionated surface wins > big broad examples. We'll iterate after launch based on telemetry.
